title: Budget-conscious intern, common room
persona: Wei, 22, a summer intern at a bank in Raffles Place. First time renting alone, on a tight stipend.
situation: Knows exactly what she wants: a cheap common room with a short-ish commute to the CBD.

turns.content: Hi, I'm looking for a room to rent. My budget is around $900 a month.
A common room is fine. I work near Raffles Place so somewhere I can get to the CBD in under 40 min by MRT.
I'd prefer a female-only unit and I don't cook much. Available from September.
Can you show me a few options and tell me which one you'd pick?
